paper.title: Offshore Wind Farm Layout Optimization Accounting for Participation in Secondary Reserve Markets

paper_problem.decision_variables: x-y coordinates of 72 Northwind V112-3.075 MW turbines
paper_problem.constraints: released Northwind polygon and minimum spacing 2 rotor diameters = 224 m
paper_problem.wake: Bastankhah/Niayifar Gaussian deficit, Crespo-Hernandez added turbulence, linear superposition and released V112 power/Ct curve

method.optimizer: SGD-equivalent Adam implementation with differentiable constraints

missing_and_conflicts.source: no fixed random seeds or released recorder corpus
missing_and_conflicts.resolution: declared seeds 0 through 4, trained from scratch

missing_and_conflicts.source: implemented inside external PyWake and not exposed in WINDFLOWER
missing_and_conflicts.resolution: freeze one aggregate factor against published 2023 base-layout AEP; do not tune per case

missing_and_conflicts.paper: 3% Gaussian modelling error is part of Eq. 3
missing_and_conflicts.source: implementation line is commented because it does not work with autograd
missing_and_conflicts.resolution: paper-first 3% error retained through LibTorch autograd

parallel_regions: integer contracted-power and reserve bid candidates
automatic differentiation and optimizer tensor updates

local_h6_candidate.workload: two optimization steps plus 512-quarter-hour JERM evaluation, K*T=150 and S=10
local_h6_candidate.objective_identity: bitwise equal across CPU worker counts

formal_protocol.paper_cases: AEP, DAEM and JERM; K*T 20/50/100/150; Rmax 50/117/221.4 MW; 2023 training and 2024 unseen evaluation
formal_protocol.execution: bounded paper-shape calibration selects the faster of CUDA and all-core CPU on Waffle

claim_boundary: Academic paper-first reconstruction using exact released layouts, curves and market data; not author-original software and not per-number identity.
